description: This file defines a base class for strategies that determine when a user has stopped speaking, including event handling, setup, and utility methods, as well as a data class for parameters emitted when a user turn stops.

classes.name: UserTurnStoppedParams
classes.description: Parameters emitted when a user turn stops, indicating whether user speaking frames should be emitted.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Base class for strategies that determine when the user stops speaking, providing event registration, setup, and frame processing methods.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with a given task manager.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the strategy.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the strategy to its initial state.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Analyzes an incoming frame to determine if the user has stopped speaking.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream.

methods.name: broadcast_frame
methods.description: Broadcasts a frame to other components.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Triggers the event indicating the user has stopped speaking.
